title: Castlefield Viaduct – Enabling Works
description: Enabling works at Castlefield Viaduct, Manchester, to support Phase 2 of the public access and greenspace scheme being delivered with the National Trust. The works comprise site investigation, clearance of drainage channels and a full tactile examination of the structure, including possession and isolation of the live railway.

title: Berwick Bypass Weather Station – New Electricity Supply Connection
description: Provision of a new unmetered electricity supply connection for the Berwick Bypass weather station at Berwick-upon-Tweed, Northumberland. The works include installation of low voltage mains and service cabling, associated excavation and reinstatement, electrical jointing, a pole mounted transformer and connection to the electricity distribution network.

title: A66 Kirkby Thore and Bassenthwaite Lake Enforcement Camera Maintenance 2026
description: Annual maintenance services for the A66 Kirkby Thore and Bassenthwaite Lake enforcement camera systems, provided by JENOPTIK UK Ltd. The services cover maintenance of the existing enforcement camera equipment for the period 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026, supporting the continued operation of the enforcement systems on the strategic road network.
